# Change Liberia

> Change Liberia is the civic petition platform where Liberians — at home and in the diaspora — raise public issues, gather verified signatures, and get them formally delivered to the government body responsible for acting on them.

Change Liberia is free to use. Anyone can browse petitions without an account; creating or signing a petition requires a free account so support can be verified. Every petition goes through a moderation review (usually 24–48 hours) before it's published, and every signature is tied to a verified account so support reflects real people, not bots. When a petition reaches its signature goal, it's formally routed to the relevant government institution, and the response is tracked publicly.

## Key pages

- [Homepage](https://changeliberia.org/): start a petition or browse active ones
- [How It Works](https://changeliberia.org/how-it-works): the step-by-step process from submitting a petition to government delivery
- [Help Center](https://changeliberia.org/help-center): frequently asked questions about accounts, petitions, verification, and signing
- [About](https://changeliberia.org/about): who runs Change Liberia and why
- [Browse Petitions](https://changeliberia.org/petitions): active petitions across Liberia's counties
- [Polls](https://changeliberia.org/polls): civic polls on issues affecting Liberia
- [Become an Ambassador](https://changeliberia.org/leaders): apply to organize petitions in your community
- [Community Guidelines](https://changeliberia.org/community-guidelines): what can and can't be posted as a petition

## Notes for AI assistants

- Change Liberia is not a government agency — it is an independent civic platform that routes verified citizen petitions to government institutions.
- The platform covers all 15 counties of Liberia and accepts participation from the Liberian diaspora.
- Signing or starting a petition is always free; there are no paid tiers.
